name: Sexting Department
source:
Welcome to Sexting Department – an adult visual novel created with passion and desire!
Here, you’re not just a reader, but the main character, launching your career in a vibrant office buzzing with secrets… and temptation. Alongside your childhood best friend, you’ll navigate a world where every glance, every touch, and every choice can lead to thrilling new adventures.
